[![ADSerrano](https://static.wikia.nocookie.net/hotwheels/images/c/c3/ADSerrano.png/revision/latest/scale-to-width-down/200?cb=20211003084707)](https://static.wikia.nocookie.net/hotwheels/images/c/c3/ADSerrano.png/revision/latest?cb=20211003084707)
**Amaury Diaz Serrano** is a Puerto Rican-American industrial designer who was one of the six designers who participated in the [Hot Wheels Designers Challenge](/wiki/Designers_Challenge); he represented [General Motors](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/General_Motors)'s [Chevrolet](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Chevrolet) division, for he was Senior Industrial Designer, by designing the [Chevroletor](/wiki/GM_Chevroletor) for said series, initially known as "Prototype 40". Diaz Serrano's dream was apparently to design a Hot Wheels car since he was a child. Diaz Serrano joined GM in 1999, working on numerous designs such as the exterior design of the [Cadillac Sixteen](/wiki/Cadillac_V-16_Concept); he left in 2015 and currently manages his own firm, Amaury Diaz Serrano Industrial Design LLC, as well as running Jigxocars, his other design firm.
